dates.quote: The Chronicles also mention the battle inside Majapahit capital in 1478 AD or 1400 Saka.

The latter state that the kingdom collapsed in 1478 AD or 1400 Saka while the Chronicles mention that there was a rebellion or civil war which destroyed the keraton or palace in which Majapahit king resided in Trowulan in that year (Birsyada 2016).
